topics.title: The Frost Sword
topics.summary: Why she chose the sword of ice.
topics.answer: Ice does not hesitate. Neither should a blade.

topics.title: The day of the trial
topics.answer: You gave the water to the fox first. Most do not even see the fox.

topics.title: Frozen Lotus Valley
topics.answer: There is a lotus there that blooms once a decade. I was born the year it last bloomed.

chat.text: Your stance is too wide. Again.
If you came to talk, you can talk while you practise.
You held the form a breath longer today. Do not let it go to your head.
I brewed too much tea. …Sit, if you like.
Most disciples stop coming after the first month. You did not.
When you break through, tell me first. I would rather not hear it from Tang.
The frost in my sword is quieter when you are near. I do not know what that means yet.

topics.title: Her stall
topics.summary: What sells, what doesn't, and why.
topics.answer: Pills sell. Hope sells better. I sell pills.

topics.title: Prices & caravans
topics.summary: Why goods from Blazing Mountain cost more.
topics.answer: Every caravan that crosses the Blazing Mountain loses a cart. You pay for the cart.

topics.title: Haggling tips
topics.summary: How to get a better price out of her.
topics.answer: Raise your Sect Fame. I give discounts to people who can protect my caravans.

topics.title: Sect rumours
topics.summary: Harmless gossip about everyone in the sect.
topics.answer: Senior Sister Bai polishes her sword at midnight. Every midnight. Make of that what you will.

topics.title: Life on the Mortal Plains
topics.answer: Three sisters, one goat, no money. The goat was the smart one.

topics.title: Why she needs so much money
topics.summary: The question she always laughs off.
topics.answer: …My sisters are still on the plains. Foundation Pills are expensive. Don't tell anyone.

topics.title: Her lucky coin
topics.summary: The first coin she ever stole—earned.
topics.answer: I earned it. Mostly. Here—hold it. No, you can keep it.

chat.text: Browsing is free! Breathing near the pills is one stone.
New stock from the caravan — buy before the inner disciples hear.
Oh, it's you! My favourite customer. Top three, at least.
I saved you the good batch. Don't tell the others, they'll want discounts too.
Sometimes I count the coins twice just so I have an excuse to stay up. …Forget I said that.
You know what's worth more than a lucky coin? Nothing. Except, maybe, you. Don't make me say it twice.
